demo.text:
v1 prototype: visual baseline only

Superseded by v2 (below):
• Status transition rules: the API allows any status to any status (PRD 8).
• “Viewing as” switcher and demo accounts were demo-only; the role comes from the signed-in user.
• “Most tasks” sort, 500 / 2000 description limits, project description in list rows and the “next 7 days and overdue” upcoming list do not match the API.
• Improve with AI: the endpoint is not built yet.

v2decisions.text:
v2 decisions (2026-11-11)

• Any status → any status; no final states.
• No role switcher, no demo accounts.
• Bell with unread badge, notification panel, live toasts (SSE).
• Only the dashboard is live (dashboard-changed); lists change only when the user reloads.
• Overdue KPI card; upcoming = today to today + 7 days.
• Task actions: Admin everywhere; the owning PM on project detail and task detail (owner checked with GET /api/projects/{id}); an assignee changes only the status (in list rows when assigned to me).
• Assignee picker searches /api/users/assignable; the owner picker (Admin only) searches /api/users?Role=ProjectManager.
• New tasks are created from a project page (the project is known there).
• Improve with AI: disabled “Coming soon” for Admin and PM until the AI endpoint ships (last milestone).
• Lengths match the API: name and title 200, project description 2000, task description 4000, full name 100, password 8–128 with a letter and a digit.
• Each screen names the role it is drawn for.
